focus.ja: 落下する先頭字・後続の軌跡・着地した主歌詞の対応
focus.en: Falling lead glyphs, delivery trails and their final lyric positions

intent.ja: 文字が落ちて定位置に収まる動きと、円との位置関係を見てください。
intent.en: Watch the falling letters settle and compare their position around the circle.

preserve.ja: 読む順と背景模様の動きを保ちます。拡大・縮小する文字は、輪郭の滑らかさが変わる場合があります。円に収めるため文字サイズを調整する場合があります。拡大・縮小する動きと、そのタイミングを保ちます。
preserve.en: Reading order and background motion are retained. Scaling letters may have different edge smoothness. Text size may be adjusted to fit around the circle. The scaling motion and its timing are retained.

focus.ja: 吊り札・文字・紐・支点・レールのつながり
focus.en: Connections between lyric tags, strings, pins and rail

intent.ja: 所有部材を含む吊り札のまとまりが円を避けるか確認
intent.en: Check that the tag composition and owned attachments avoid the circle

preserve.ja: 札内の文字、揺れ、支点の対応と読む順を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve tag-to-glyph attachment, swing phase, anchors and reading order.

focus.ja: 跳ねる各文字と地面の線・点・影
focus.en: Bouncing glyphs and their baseline, dots and ground shadows

intent.ja: 文字と所有する地面表現が一緒に回避するか確認
intent.en: Check joint avoidance of glyphs and their owned ground elements

preserve.ja: 字順、跳躍の位相、影が文字の下にある関係を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve reading order, bounce phase and shadows below their glyphs.

focus.ja: 3200×1080での弾性軸と文字・付属線の関係
focus.en: Elastic axis, glyphs and attached strokes at 3200×1080

intent.ja: 弾性軸を保つ文字組の回避構成を確認
intent.en: Check avoidance composition while preserving the elastic axis

preserve.ja: 文字をばらばらに移さず、伸縮方向と部材の連結を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve stretching direction and attachment; do not scatter individual glyphs.

focus.ja: 3200×1080のステッカー板とその中の各文字
focus.en: Sticker plates and their glyphs at 3200×1080

intent.ja: 板と文字を所有単位で再配置して円を避けるか確認
intent.en: Check avoidance by moving plate-and-glyph ownership groups

preserve.ja: 元の文字数、読む順、板と文字の対応を保つ
preserve.en: Preserve glyph count, reading order and plate-to-glyph correspondence.

focus.ja: 文字と枠の動き、周りに広がる光
focus.en: Moving letters, frame and surrounding glow

intent.ja: 変更後は、円の外に収まるよう発光の描き方を変えています。文字と枠の動きを見てください。
intent.en: After changes how the glow is drawn to fit outside the circle. Watch the letters and frame move.

preserve.ja: 文字と枠、発光の印象を保ちます。光の広がり方には差があります。
preserve.en: The letters, frame and glowing impression are retained. The spread of light differs.

focus.ja: キーの字・凡例・板の対応
focus.en: Key glyphs, legends and their plate

intent.ja: 文字とキーの板が一緒に円を避ける動きを見てください。
intent.en: Watch the letters and key plates move together around the circle.

preserve.ja: キーの並びと、文字と板のつながりを保ちます。拡大・縮小する文字は、輪郭の滑らかさが変わる場合があります。円に収めるため文字サイズを調整する場合があります。拡大・縮小する動きと、そのタイミングを保ちます。
preserve.en: Key order and the connection between each letter and its plate are retained. Scaling letters may have different edge smoothness. Text size may be adjusted to fit around the circle. The scaling motion and its timing are retained.

focus.ja: 泡ごとの語と丸い所有板
focus.en: Words and their owned bubble plates

intent.ja: 泡と中の言葉が一緒に円を避ける動きを見てください。
intent.en: Watch each bubble and its word move together around the circle.

preserve.ja: 語順と、泡と言葉のつながりを保ちます。拡大・縮小する文字は、輪郭の滑らかさが変わる場合があります。円に収めるため文字サイズを調整する場合があります。拡大・縮小する動きと、そのタイミングを保ちます。
preserve.en: Word order and the connection between each bubble and its word are retained. Scaling letters may have different edge smoothness. Text size may be adjusted to fit around the circle. The scaling motion and its timing are retained.
